correctness.rationale: The stable non-Hermitian no-jump generator K=-iJA-kappa P/2 has all eigenvalues in the open left half-plane: any eigenvector with zero decay at site 1 is zero by nearest-neighbor recurrence. The unique Hermitian solution T of K†T+TK=-I equals integrated survival. I independently verified the even/odd separation matrix ansatz and boundary row cancellation: diagonal T_ss=(N+1-s)(s/kappa+(s-1)kappa/(4J^2)); optimization by strict convexity and s=1 exception follow. Independently solved finite Lyapunov systems in Python for N=2..9 and J=.7,kappa=1.9, with errors under 1e-14; this numerics corroborates but does not prove the all-N statement.
